title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: After a successful beta, Spyglass is now officially launched, empowering all users with powerful new insights and capabilities.

title: Advanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Enjoy greater flexibility in managing your images and files, with new controls to customize their display and streamline your workflow directly within the editor.

title: Our Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new interactive roadmap to see recently shipped updates, what's coming next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Revamped Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a more seamless workflow with bigger, easier-to-click, and fully draggable checkboxes that elevate your task management experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Work together effortlessly with clearer indicators that make it simple to see what your team is doing, ensuring everyone stays perfectly in sync.

title: Enhanced Discovery of Shared Ideas
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all ideas and quests shared by your network, with relevant content now appearing seamlessly in your searches and dedicated views.

title: Unlock Global Reach: Multilingual Support
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in your preferred language, as we introduce full support for international languages to serve our global community.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower our users with maximum control, direct involvement in our project's growth, and complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Network
summary: Transform your knowledge base into an interactive network with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities, making exploration and workflow initiation effortless.

title: Enhanced Search & Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Unleash the power of your knowledge base by applying refined filters and saving your most relevant search results into custom, easily accessible collections.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Get ready to experience a more intuitive and flexible way to visualize your linked content, providing rich context and boosting your productivity.

title: Noeko: Flexible Deployment and Premium Plans
summary: Noeko is evolving to offer exciting new self-hosting capabilities and flexible premium plans, empowering you to deploy and scale on your terms.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polishes
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing a collection of exciting new options to personalize your experience.

title: More Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're refining our homepage greetings to precisely reflect the time of day, ensuring a consistently welcoming and personalized experience for every user.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Streamline your workflow with the ability to swiftly remove multiple items from a tag directly within the tag view, making content organization more efficient than ever.

title: Unlock More Content: New Source Integrations
summary: Get ready to effortlessly bring in and engage with information from various new sources such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making your knowledge gathering more comprehensive.
